cards.public_summary: Josh Jacobs is facing charges, and the Packers said they are cooperating with the NFL while the matter is reviewed.
cards.evidence:
Clearly, the Packers are not cutting Jacobs -- at least not at this point.

[Responding to]: Statement from the Packers: 

“We are aware of the charges brought against Josh Jacobs. We will continue to cooperate with the NFL as we work through the process. We will have no further comment at this time.”
cards.commentary: This creates potential availability risk, but there is no announced team action, NFL discipline or timetable. Monitor for league or team updates.
cards.author: RobDemovsky
